Good morning, Japan.
lines.zh: 早上好，日本。

lines.en: I had sex last night.
lines.zh: 我昨晚做爱了。

lines.en: Which is something I can say about most nights, honestly.
lines.zh: 说实话，大多数晚上我都能这么说。

lines.en: But this was the first time I’ve gotten to do it with {i}Niki{/i} ever since doing it with her sister. Which means I have finally unified their family and we can all go back to being normal now.
lines.zh: 但这是自从跟她妹妹做过之后，我第一次跟{i}Niki{/i}做。这意味着我终于统一了她们家，我们现在都可以回归正常了。

lines.en: Chances are, though, this could just be a one-time thing as I work my way out of the dog-house. But it still feels good knowing things are on their way to resembling normalcy again.
lines.zh: 不过，在我努力从狗窝里爬出来的过程中，这大概只是一次性的事。可知道一切又在慢慢恢复正常，感觉还是很好的。

lines.en: Plus, I got to make her feel really good about herself after I only lasted approximately two minutes. I’ll have to thank Nodoka and her {i}models{/i} for the assist with that, though.
lines.zh: 而且，虽然我只坚持了大概两分钟，我还是让她对自己感觉非常好。不过这得感谢 Nodoka 和她的{i}模型{/i}帮忙。

lines.en: Either way, if Niki is going to wage war on the girls of Class 1-A, it makes perfect sense that she’d want to assert dominance over them any chance she gets.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，如果 Niki 打算对 1-A 班的女生开战，她想逮着机会就确立支配地位，这也完全说得通。

lines.en: And what better time to do that than now, when she can stake her claim in front of everyone while subtly pushing away a lot of the girls who have effectively accepted they’re fighting a losing battle?
lines.zh: 而还有什么时机比现在更好？她可以在所有人面前宣示主权，同时不动声色地把许多已经默认自己在打一场必败之战的女生推开。

lines.en: scene ayaneiotrivia1

But then, of course, there are those who don’t really understand that they’re in the midst of war at all because they keep mistaking gunfire for fireworks. And I’m not sure how Niki will handle people like that.
lines.zh: 不过当然，也有人根本不明白自己正身处战争之中，因为她们总把枪声误当成烟花。而我不确定 Niki 会怎么对付这样的人。

lines.en: : Good morning, girls! And good morning to my totally platonic friend, Akira, who I have never done anything questionable with at any point in {i}either{/i} of our lives!
lines.zh: : 早上好，姑娘们！也向我完全柏拉图式的朋友 Akira 问好——在我们{i}各自{/i}的人生里，我从来没有跟他做过任何可疑的事！

lines.en: : How specific.
lines.zh: : 说得真具体。

lines.en: : Sorry for missing your girlfriend yesterday, by the way. Your girlfriend who {i}isn’t{/i} Imani, just in case anybody misunderstood that and is now tempted to get them fired. I’m talking about the idol.
lines.zh: : 顺便说一句，很遗憾昨天错过了你的女朋友。那位{i}不是{/i} Imani 的女朋友——免得有人误会，还想害她们被开除。我说的是那个偶像。

lines.en: scene ayaneiotrivia2

: Where’s she now, though? I kind of expected her to be here after hearing about the leash she had you on. It’s not safe to let dogs like you roam free, you know. They might take advantage of drunk girls or something.
lines.zh: : 那她现在在哪儿？听说了她把你拴得多紧之后，我还挺期待她会来的。让像你这样的狗到处乱跑可不安全，你知道吗。它们说不定会趁机对喝醉的女生下手什么的。

lines.en: : Ignoring how that isn’t a thing dogs have been known to do outside of illegal fetish material or hentai, I will say that I’m glad to see you’ve broken free, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 先不管这种事除了在非法癖好素材或成人动画里，狗从来没被记载过会干——我得说，看到你重获自由我很高兴，Sensei。

lines.en: : I think I speak for all of us when I say that we were worried we might never see you again after your {i}girlfriend{/i} showed up to directly challenge every single one of us at once. Bold move, I’ll admit.
lines.zh: : 我想我可以代表大家说：在你{i}女朋友{/i}现身、一次性直接向我们每一个人下战书之后，我们都担心再也见不到你了。这招挺大胆，我承认。

lines.en: scene ayaneiotrivia3
: Challenge you at {i}what,{/i} Makoto?
lines.zh: : 向你下{i}什么{/i}战书，Makoto？

lines.en: : Could it be that all of you girls are {i}also{/i} trying to become Akira’s girlfriends and that the only reason you aren’t as excited about the Niki thing as me is that you see her as competition?
lines.zh: : 会不会是你们这些女生{i}也{/i}都想成为 Akira 的女朋友，而你们对 Niki 这件事没我这么兴奋的唯一原因，就是把她当成了竞争对手？

lines.en: : You’re not excited either. I think you’re just misinterpreting all the rage swimming around in your head right now as unbridled joy.
lines.zh: : 你也不兴奋啊。我觉得你只是把脑子里游来游去的怒火误当成了纯粹的喜悦。

lines.en: : I can assure you that all of the rage I feel right now is for Imani and not myself.
lines.zh: : 我可以向你保证，我现在所有的怒火都是冲着 Imani 的，不是冲我自己。

lines.en: : Oh? Then could it be that {i}she{/i} is trying to become Sensei’s girlfriend and you’re only pointing fingers at {i}us{/i} right now to distract us from the potential extra-curricular fraternization of coworkers?
lines.zh: : 哦？那会不会是{i}她{/i}想成为 Sensei 的女朋友，而你现在只是把矛头指向{i}我们{/i}，好转移我们对同事之间可能的课外亲密关系的注意？

lines.en: : Could be. I can’t give you an honest answer until I learn what “fraternization” means.
lines.zh: : 有可能。在搞清楚「fraternization」是什么意思之前，我没法给你一个诚实的回答。

lines.en: scene ayaneiotrivia4
: If you guys are going to stand there and riff all morning, do I have time to go get breakfast? It’s bad enough that Uta overslept, but now I have to answer questions {i}hungry?{/i}
lines.zh: : 如果你俩要站在这儿斗一上午嘴，我还有时间去吃个早饭吗？Uta 睡过头已经够糟了，现在我还得{i}饿着肚子{/i}答题？

lines.en: : If there even {i}are{/i} questions, I mean. And that this isn’t just the opening to Miku’s skit contest thing and I misread the schedule.
lines.zh: : 我是说，如果{i}真的有{/i}问题的话。而且前提这不是 Miku 那个小品比赛的开场，是我看错日程了。

lines.en: : Are you even in this class? Who are you?
lines.zh: : 你是这个班的吗？你谁啊？

lines.en: : Oops. You got me. I’ll be taking my leave, now.
lines.zh: : 哎呀。被你发现了。那我先走了。

lines.en: : Stay right there, Io. You’re a part of this class whether you like it or not.
lines.zh: : 站住别动，Io。不管你喜不喜欢，你都是这个班的一员。

lines.en: scene ayaneiotrivia5
: Why even add the “or not” part when you already know I don’t like it? Just get this over with already. I’ve done it before. I know the drill.
lines.zh: : 你明知道我不喜欢，干嘛还要加「或不是」那部分？赶紧搞定吧。我以前干过。我懂流程。

lines.en: : You can do it, Io! If {i}I{/i} can win at the trivia thingy, {i}anybody{/i} can!
lines.zh: : 你能行的，Io！连{i}我{/i}都能在那个冷知识比赛里赢，{i}任何人{/i}都行！

lines.en: : Didn’t you lose?
lines.zh: : 你不是输了吗？

lines.en: scene ayaneiotrivia6
: You {i}never{/i} lose so long as everybody has a good time.
lines.zh: : 只要大家玩得开心，你就{i}永远不会{/i}输。

lines.en: : Yes you do. You probably just purged the loss from your mind since it was to fucking {i}Yasu{/i} of all people.
lines.zh: : 你输了。你大概只是把那次失败从脑子里抹掉了，毕竟输给的是{i}Yasu{/i}那种人。

lines.en: : Why are you even over here? Your team’s cheering section is off to the right.
lines.zh: : 你跑这边来干嘛？你们队的啦啦队在右边呢。

lines.en: : I’m fillin’ in for Uta since she’s still tired and sad after tryin’ to pork Sensei’s girlfriend. It ain’t right if Io’s only got one person in her corner, ya know?
lines.zh: : 我是来替 Uta 的，她想睡 Sensei 女朋友没成，现在又累又难过。Io 这边只有一个人的话也太不像话了，你懂吧？

lines.en: scene ayaneiotrivia7
: I think that’s exactly how many people Io wants in her corner, honestly.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我觉得那正好就是 Io 希望自己这边有的人数。

lines.en: : I just don’t get why we couldn’t do all of this online.
lines.zh: : 我就是不明白，这些为什么不能全在线上搞。

lines.en: : Technology is poisoning the minds of today’s youth. And I will be damned if I let one of my nineteen favorite students fall victim to it.
lines.zh: : 科技正在毒害当今年轻人的心智。我绝不会让我十九个最喜爱的学生之一成为它的受害者。

lines.en: : Is the twentieth student you forgot to include me? Because I exist on a plane much greater and cuter than everybody else?
lines.zh: : 你漏掉没算的第二十个学生是我吧？毕竟我存在于一个比所有人都更伟大、更可爱的层面？

lines.en: : No. It’s Otoha since she’s the only one who isn’t in love with me yet.
lines.zh: : 不是。是 Otoha，因为她是唯一一个还没爱上我的。

lines.en: : Stop stealing all the girls I’m attracted to and maybe it’ll make me like you more.
lines.zh: : 别再把我喜欢的女生都抢走了，说不定这样我会更喜欢你一点。

lines.en: : Is it really stealing if he had them all first?
lines.zh: : 如果那些人本来就是他先有的，那也算偷吗？

lines.en: : Yeah, I’d say so.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我觉得算。

lines.en: : Stealing requires some amount of effort. And you’re unfortunately wrong to believe that this man would ever so much as consider partaking in such a thing.
lines.zh: : 偷是需要付出一定努力的。而你很不幸地错了——你居然相信这个男人会哪怕考虑去做这种事。

lines.en: : Wow, you’re sure all {i}very{/i} fond of your teacher!
lines.zh: : 哇，你们对老师的感情{i}可真{/i}深啊！

lines.en: scene ayaneiotrivia8
: It’s almost as if you’re {i}in love{/i} with him...
lines.zh: : 简直就像是{i}爱上{/i}他了……

lines.en: : Isn’t that exactly what Sensei just-
lines.zh: : 这不正是 Sensei 刚才说的——

lines.en: : Ignore her, Ayane. Rika does not possess the brain power needed to closely follow the threads of communication.
lines.zh: : 别理她，Ayane。Rika 没有足够脑力来跟上对话的脉络。

lines.en: scene ayaneiotrivia9
: Hey, how come you call the other teachers, like...Miss Imai or Miss Watabe, but I’m just {i}Rika?{/i}
lines.zh: : 嘿，你管别的老师叫 Imai 老师、Watabe 老师什么的，为什么就叫我{i}Rika{/i}？

lines.en: : Easy. You’re not a teacher and I don’t respect you.
lines.zh: : 简单。你不是老师，我也不尊重你。

lines.en: : Is it the tattoos?
lines.zh: : 是因为纹身吗？

lines.en: : No, it’s the brain.
lines.zh: : 不是，是因为脑子。

lines.en: : What brain?
lines.zh: : 什么脑子？

lines.en: : Exactly.
lines.zh: : 正是。

lines.en: scene ayaneiotrivia10

: Okay, Makoto can make fun of me as much as she wants, but the fact is that you can be a trivia expert {i}without{/i} possessing above-average intellect! Which is precisely why I was chosen to host this event!
lines.zh: : 好吧，Makoto 爱怎么取笑我就怎么取笑，可事实是：你{i}不需要{/i}有超常的智力也能成为冷知识专家！这正是我被选来主持这场活动的原因！

lines.en: : I believe you were trusted with this one because it was the easiest.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你被托付这个，是因为它最简单。

lines.en: : That’s what you guys said about the death ball, so I just don’t trust anyone anymore.
lines.zh: : 你们当初也是这么评价死亡球的，所以我再也不相信任何人了。

lines.en: scene ayaneiotrivia11
: The rules are simple, though. Makoto and I are going to read some questions off of these cards and the two of you will answer them.
lines.zh: : 不过规则很简单。我和 Makoto 会念卡片上的问题，你们俩来回答。

lines.en: : The thing is, pure intellect will only take you so far because we’re going with {i}my{/i} specialty here — bar trivia! So an assortment of mostly random stuff that will never really help you in real life.
lines.zh: : 问题是，光靠纯粹的智力走不了多远，因为我们这儿用的是{i}我{/i}的专长——酒吧冷知识！所以基本都是一堆在现实生活里从来派不上用场的随机问题。

lines.en: : Unless real life lands you at a bar and it happens to be trivia night. I imagine this would come in handy there. Unless sign-ups were the day before. Or if you’re just shy.
lines.zh: : 除非你的现实生活把你带到了一家酒吧，而那天又恰好是冷知识之夜。我想那会儿就能派上用场了。除非报名是前一天。或者你就是害羞。

lines.en: : Or hey, maybe you {i}are{/i} at the bar and you signed up for trivia and everything is going totally well, but then some guy’s phone goes off and it’s actually your daughter texting him about gorillas but, like, sexually.
lines.zh: : 或者嘿，也许你{i}确实{/i}在酒吧、报了冷知识比赛，一切都进展得特别顺利，结果某个男人的手机响了，而发短信的其实是你女儿，内容是跟大猩猩有关的、呃、色情的东西。

lines.en: : Are you done?
lines.zh: : 你说完了吗？

lines.en: scene ayaneiotrivia12
: With what?
lines.zh: : 说完什么？

lines.en: : {i}Hah...{/i}shout out the answer if you know it. No turns this time. What was the name of the Grinch’s dog in How the-
lines.zh: {i}哈……{/i}知道的话就把答案喊出来。这次不轮流派人。《圣诞怪杰》里那只狗叫什么名字来着——

lines.en: : Max!
lines.zh: : Max！

lines.en: scene ayaneiotrivia13
: Oh, wow. I didn’t even finish the question yet.
lines.zh: : 哦，哇。我问题都还没念完呢。

lines.en: : I mean...the Grinch kind of only appears in one thing.
lines.zh: : 我是说……圣诞怪杰基本上只在一部作品里出现。

lines.en: : False! There have been a bunch of spin-offs he’s appeared in too. Like “The Hoobub and the Grinch” or “The Grinch Grinches the Cat in the Hat.”
lines.zh: : 错！他还出演过一堆衍生作品。比如《Hoobub 与圣诞怪杰》或者《圣诞怪杰捉弄戴帽子的猫》。

lines.en: : Are you some kind of Grinch expert or something?
lines.zh: : 你是圣诞怪杰专家还是怎么的？

lines.en: : I am a {i}Christmas{/i} expert. And there can be no Christmas without the Grinch.
lines.zh: : 我是{i}圣诞节{/i}专家。而没有圣诞怪杰就没有圣诞节。

lines.en: : What the fuck is Christmas?
lines.zh: : 圣诞节是他妈什么玩意儿？

lines.en: : Sorry. Christmalloween.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。是圣诞万圣节。

lines.en: : Correct me if I’m wrong...but wasn’t his whole thing, like...trying to {i}stop{/i} Christmalloween?
lines.zh: : 要是我说错了请纠正……可他的整个故事不就是想{i}阻止{/i}圣诞万圣节吗？

lines.en: scene ayaneiotrivia14
: Yeah, but then his heart grew three sizes when he realized that the value of it comes from {i}there{/i} and not all of the gifts!
lines.zh: : 是啊，可后来他的心胀大了三倍，因为他意识到它的价值来自{i}那里{/i}，而不是所有的礼物！

lines.en: : Plus, if you watched the 2000’s Jim Carrey movie, you’d know he was only grumpy because he was bullied in school and-
lines.zh: : 再说，如果你看过 2000 年代那部金·凯瑞的电影，你就会知道他脾气坏只是因为在学校被霸凌——

lines.en: : Okay, okay. We get it. You like the Grinch. Next question please.
lines.zh: : 好了好了。明白了。你喜欢圣诞怪杰。下一题吧。

lines.en: scene ayaneiotrivia15
: You know, Io’s kind of like the Grinch too when you think about it, isn’t she? Loner. Grumpy. Green. You don’t have a dog, do you?
lines.zh: : 你知道么，仔细想想 Io 也有点像圣诞怪杰，不是吗？独来独往。脾气坏。一身绿。你没养狗吧？

lines.en: : No, just a dead cat. Also, don’t talk to me. Next-
lines.zh: : 没有，只有一只死掉的猫。还有，别跟我说话。下一——

lines.en: : Which shoe did Cinderella leave at the-
lines.zh: : 灰姑娘把哪只鞋落在了——

lines.en: scene ayaneiotrivia16
: The left one.
lines.zh: : 左脚那只。

lines.en: : Bingo! Which brings the score to one point for Ayane, and one point for the girl who isn’t Ayane.
lines.zh: : 答对了！比分变成 Ayane 一分，不是 Ayane 的那个女生也一分。

lines.en: : I’m surprised you knew that, Io. That was really quick.
lines.zh: : 我很惊讶你知道这个，Io。答得真快。

lines.en: scene ayaneiotrivia17

: Oh, I didn’t. I just figured there was a 50%% chance of me getting the correct answer with a guess and that failing to answer correctly wouldn’t just give {i}you{/i} the point since that would be unfair.
lines.zh: : 哦，我不知道。我只是想，瞎猜有 50%% 的几率答对，而就算答错也不该直接把分数给{i}你{/i}，那样不公平。

lines.en: : Hey! Didn’t I say no intellect earlier?! Question three — which type of house cat is almost exclusively female?
lines.zh: : 嘿！我刚才不是说了不靠智力吗？！第三题——哪种家猫几乎全是母的？

lines.en: scene ayaneiotrivia18
: Oh! Calico! That one I actually know.
lines.zh: : 哦！三花猫！这个我确实知道。

lines.en: : Correct. Point to Io.
lines.zh: : 正确。Io 得一分。

lines.en: : {i}Ahem.{/i} I’ll be the judge of that, other girl I can’t remember the name of. {i}Point{/i} to Io!
lines.zh: {i}咳咳。{/i}这个由我来判定，那个我记不住名字的女生。{i}给{/i} Io 加分！

lines.en: scene ayaneiotrivia19
: Does Rin’s mom have some sort of bias against flat girls with a green motif? Is Molly a part of this too? Is {i}that{/i} why Rin rejected her?
lines.zh: : Rin 的妈妈是不是对一身绿色主题的平胸女生有什么偏见？Molly 也算其中一个吗？{i}那{/i}就是 Rin 拒绝她的原因？

lines.en: : Uhh, I guess it’s my turn to read one? How many reindeer does Santa-
lines.zh: : 呃，轮到我念题了？圣诞老人有多少只驯鹿——

lines.en: scene ayaneiotrivia20
: Eight! Nine, counting Rudolph!
lines.zh: : 八只！算上鲁道夫就是九只！

lines.en: : How many Christmalloween questions are there going to be?!
lines.zh: : 到底还会有多少圣诞万圣节的问题啊？！

lines.en: : I don’t know, but keep them coming! I can do this all day!
lines.zh: : 我不知道，但尽管来吧！我能答一整天！

lines.en: : That’s the spirit, Ayane! And since you’re the expert, maybe you’ll know this {i}next{/i} one too!
lines.zh: : 就是这个劲头，Ayane！既然你是专家，也许{i}下一{/i}题你也知道！

lines.en: : What’s the diameter of an average basketball hoop?
lines.zh: : 普通篮球筐的直径是多少？

lines.en: scene ayaneiotrivia21
: What? How am I the expert on that? I don’t play basketball.
lines.zh: : 什么？我怎么会是这方面的专家？我又不打篮球。

lines.en: : I just figured that Santa climbing through chimneys wasn’t all that far off from Lebron James sinking threes.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得，圣诞老人爬烟囱跟勒布朗·詹姆斯投三分也没差多远。

lines.en: : I don’t know. A foot, maybe?
lines.zh: : 我不知道。大概一英尺？

lines.en: : It’s probably, like...what, eighteen inches or something?
lines.zh: : 大概是……那个，十八英寸什么的？

lines.en: scene ayaneiotrivia22
: It...is! Good job, Io! The girl whose name I now remember!
lines.zh: : 就……就是这个！干得好，Io！那个我现在记住名字的女生！

lines.en: : Hooray. The anti-green stigma has been dismantled. We did it.
lines.zh: : 万岁。反绿色的污名被打破了。我们做到了。

lines.en: : Atta girl, Io! So long as they stop askin’ holiday stuff, you’ve got this in the bag!
lines.zh: : 好样的，Io！只要他们别再问节日相关的，你就稳了！

lines.en: : That one was mostly a guess too. I just visualized a basketball in my hands and tried to guess based on the size of that.
lines.zh: : 那题也基本是猜的。我只是在脑子里想象手里捧着个篮球，然后根据那个大小来猜。

lines.en: : Probably all that carpentry shit coming in handy. People good at that can basically just measure stuff with their eyes, right?
lines.zh: : 大概是那点木工本事派上用场了。擅长这个的人基本上用眼睛就能量东西，对吧？

lines.en: : If that’s true, there’s something I’ve always wanted to measure but haven’t ever gotten around to. Think you could help with that next?
lines.zh: : 如果真是这样，有样东西我一直想量量，可一直没腾出手。你觉得接下来能帮我这个忙吗？

lines.en: : Maya, come on.
lines.zh: : Maya，别闹了。

lines.en: : Oh, as if you don’t also want to know.
lines.zh: : 哦，说得好像你不想知道似的。

lines.en: scene ayaneiotrivia23
: Size doesn’t matter, guys! It’s just a pointless thing people focus on for no reason. Like UFOs. Or the age disparity between a teenage girl and the man she’s going to marry.
lines.zh: : 尺寸不重要，各位！那只是人们毫无理由地纠结的没意义的东西。就像 UFO。或者少女和要娶她的那个男人之间的年龄差。

lines.en: : Size totally matters and the idea that it doesn’t is just propaganda spread by a bunch of tiny-dicked rich dudes.
lines.zh: : 尺寸完全重要，而「不重要」那套说法只是一群小几把有钱人散布的宣传。

lines.en: : Try putting AAA batteries in a AA slot and you’ll see for yourself just how hard turning shit on can be if you don’t have the right equipment to get the job done.
lines.zh: : 你试试把 AAA 电池塞进 AA 的槽里，就会明白没有合适的装备，想打开什么东西有多难。

lines.en: : You do realize Sensei’s still here, right?
lines.zh: : 你该知道 Sensei 还在这儿吧？

lines.en: : Sure do, but he has nothing to worry about. Platonically, of course.
lines.zh: : 当然知道，可他没什么好担心的。当然是柏拉图意义上的。

lines.en: : You can’t just add “platonically” to things to make them safe for work!
lines.zh: : 你不能随随便便加个「柏拉图式」就让事情变得适合工作场合！

lines.en: : Sure I can. This {i}is{/i} my work. Do I tell you how to do {i}your{/i} job?
lines.zh: : 我当然能。这{i}就是{/i}我的工作。我有教过你怎么干{i}你{/i}的活儿吗？

lines.en: : My job is loving Sensei. The only one who can tell me what to do is him.
lines.zh: : 我的工作就是爱 Sensei。唯一能指挥我的人是他。

lines.en: : He’s paying you? How much?
lines.zh: : 他还付你钱？多少？

lines.en: : Can we-
lines.zh: : 我们能不能——

lines.en: : If I pay you double, will you love my daughter instead? I think you’d be a good influence on her and she’s very susceptible to blondes.
lines.zh: : 如果我付你双倍，你会改去爱我女儿吗？我觉得你会对她有好的影响，而且她特别吃金发那一套。

lines.en: : I’m straight.
lines.zh: : 我是直的。

lines.en: : That’s what they all say until they’re not.
lines.zh: : 她们都这么说，直到不直为止。

lines.en: : Can we keep going?
lines.zh: : 我们能继续吗？

lines.en: scene ayaneiotrivia24
: They say that too.
lines.zh: : 这句她们也说过。

lines.en: scene ayaneiotrivia25
: Next question — what is a single string of spaghetti called?
lines.zh: : 下一题——一根意大利面叫什么？

lines.en: scene ayaneiotrivia13
: A spaghetto!
lines.zh: : Spaghetto！

lines.en: : There’s no fucking way.
lines.zh: : 他妈的不可能。

lines.en: : Correct!
lines.zh: : 正确！

lines.en: : It’s Italian for “little string.” I learned it in a cookbook.
lines.zh: : 那是意大利语里「小绳子」的意思。我是在一本食谱上学到的。

lines.en: : I don’t like the implication here that a recipe called for a specific amount of spaghettos.
lines.zh: : 我不喜欢这里暗示某份食谱会要求特定数量的 spaghettos。

lines.en: : Does this mean Sana’s only afraid when there’s more than one?
lines.zh: : 这是不是意味着 Sana 只在多于一根的时候才害怕？

lines.en: : I don’t think it’s the word that bothers her, Ami...
lines.zh: : 我觉得让她不舒服的不是这个词，Ami……

lines.en: scene black
The contest drags on for another twenty minutes or so...and stays mostly even the entire time.
lines.zh: 比赛又拖了大概二十分钟……而且全程基本保持势均力敌。

lines.en: How the two of these girls manage to possess so much miscellaneous knowledge, I don’t know. But it’s made for a decently interesting tug-of war that, in its final moments, even Io is getting into...
lines.zh: 这两个女生到底怎么装下这么多杂七杂八的知识，我不知道。不过这造就了一场相当有趣的拉锯战，到了最后关头，连 Io 都投入进去了……

lines.en: scene ayaneiotrivia26
: Okay...with a score of 49-49, I think it’s probably best if we end this contest after the next question.
lines.zh: : 好吧……比分 49 比 49，我觉得下一题之后就结束这场比赛大概是最好的。

lines.en: : I think that’s a good call. Imani’s been texting me to drag Akira over to the classroom for the next one for like five minutes now.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这个判断不错。Imani 已经给我发了大概五分钟短信，叫我赶紧把 Akira 拖去教室参加下一场。

lines.en: scene ayaneiotrivia27
: Well, that’s on her for not making sure we had enough time for {i}this{/i} one.
lines.zh: : 那也怪她，没确保{i}这{/i}一场有足够的时间。

lines.en: : Right? Like, she said these are normally pretty quick, so I didn’t think it’d be a problem. But here we are down to the wire and it’s still anybody’s game!
lines.zh: : 对吧？她说这种比赛通常很快，所以我没觉得会有问题。可现在到了最后关头，胜负还完全没定！

lines.en: : How we feeling, girls? Ayane? Io?
lines.zh: : 感觉怎么样，姑娘们？Ayane？Io？

lines.en: : Ready as I’ll ever be.
lines.zh: : 尽我所能地准备好了。

lines.en: : Same here. May the best {i}me{/i} win.
lines.zh: : 我也是。愿最强的{i}我{/i}获胜。

lines.en: : You’ve got this, Ayane. But just know that if you {i}don’t{/i} and that we wind up losing my dad to the second floor because of you, I am shipping you up there and replacing you with Kirin in Dorm 2.
lines.zh: : 你能行的，Ayane。不过你{i}要是不行{/i}、我们因为你把我爸输给了二楼，我就把你送上去，换成 Kirin 住进 2 号宿舍。

lines.en: : {i}Please.{/i} At least Ayane leaves me alone.
lines.zh: {i}求你了。{/i}至少 Ayane 不会来烦我。

lines.en: : What do you think, Makoto? We’ve gotta give them a hard one, right? Wouldn’t be the finale if we just made Ayane name another Christmalloween thing.
lines.zh: : 你觉得呢，Makoto？我们得出道难题，对吧？如果只是让 Ayane 再说一个圣诞万圣节的东西，那就不叫收官题了。

lines.en: : That’s already like eight of her points, so yes. Please no more Christmalloween questions.
lines.zh: : 光那类题都已经给她拿了大概八分了，所以没错。拜托别再有圣诞万圣节的问题了。

lines.en: : Hey, we gave you a bunch of sports ones to make up for it, didn’t we?
lines.zh: : 嘿，我们给了你一堆体育题来补偿啊，不是吗？

lines.en: scene ayaneiotrivia28
: No. I only dislike advantages when they’re given to my adversaries.
lines.zh: : 没有。我只讨厌优势被给了我的对手。

lines.en: : Just give us something neither one of us will know! We haven’t been stumped nearly enough.
lines.zh: : 就出个我们俩都不知道的吧！我们被难住的次数远远不够。

lines.en: : So basically, no Christmalloween and no sports? This one should probably work then, right?
lines.zh: : 所以基本上，不要圣诞万圣节、也不要体育？那这道题应该行了吧？

lines.en: : That one? Yeah, I guess that works. Do you want to read it, or should I?
lines.zh: : 那道？行，我觉得可以。你想念还是我来念？

lines.en: : I can do it. So listen up. Final question...
lines.zh: : 我来吧。那么听好了。最后一题……

lines.en: : Which {i}pop-{/i}ular Japanese seafood dish derives its name from the Russian language?
lines.zh: : 哪道{i}爆-{/i}受欢迎的日本海鲜料理，名字来源于俄语？

lines.en: scene ayaneiotrivia29
: Anyone?
lines.zh: : 有人知道吗？

lines.en: scene ayaneiotrivia30
: Uhh...well, assuming that your weird pronunciation of “popular” was some kind of hint...I don’t know. Ikura?
lines.zh: : 呃……好吧，假设你那个「爆」字的奇怪读法算是某种提示……我不知道。Ikura？

lines.en: scene ayaneiotrivia31
: Correct. The word “ikura” comes from the Russian “ikra,” which is essentially just fish roe. Known widely for its iconic {i}popping{/i} sensation, ikura-
lines.zh: : 正确。「ikura」这个词来自俄语的「ikra」，基本上就是鱼子。ikura 以它标志性的{i}爆浆{/i}口感广为人知——

lines.en: : You good, Ayane?
lines.zh: : 你还好吗，Ayane？

lines.en: scene ayaneiotrivia32
: Huh?
: It’s just a contest, girl. It’s not the end of the world.
lines.zh: : 只是场比赛而已，丫头。又不是世界末日。
